why: Heinrich, Kiyomi, Otachi, and Schweitzer (arXiv 2504.02353, Apr 2025) proved interval graphs with at least 3 vertices are reconstructible, settling a case of the reconstruction conjecture; the general conjecture and the new digraph reconstruction conjecture remain open per current sources.
queries: digraph reconstruction conjecture new results arXiv 2025
